coordinates: raw_offset counts bytes from the object base; tagged_displacement is the immediate added to the tagged pointer (negative displacements need explicit address adjustment on wasm32, positive ones can use the memory instruction offset)

vocabulary.inherited: value or layout adopted as-is under D1
vocabulary.unsupported: native-only mechanism with no target counterpart
vocabulary.deferred: needs a later stage or decision, referenced
vocabulary.reserved: value retained, no target use until an explicit decision
